newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Garlick cuts 11 staff after restructuring.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Garlick cuts 11 staff after restructuring.

text.p: Wellington stock brokerage Garlick & Co is to cut its staff numbers from 27 to 16, Managing Director Bill Garlick said on Thursday.
Garlick and Co said it would outsource some work to international firms it has had close associations with already.
The company, the only New Zealand institutional broker which is staff-owned, has undergone four restructurings in the past 11 years.

"The market is changing so quickly -- if you are going to remain in our position as a viable operator, you have to keep shifting your business and anticipate where the markets are going," Garlick told Reuters.
Garlick said the firm would be outsourcing much more of its work in investment banking.
He said Garlick & Co had considered selling its operation to a major foreign player but had rejected that option.
